description: Register to speak: raise, lower, invite, dismiss.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is a current participant connected to the room.
The actor holds no open request.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the participant.
cases.return: Success with Created true; the queue holds one Queued request at the next free position, stamped with the current agenda item. A Raise change is published to every reader (no invited target).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is connected to the room and already holds an open Queued request.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the same participant.
cases.return: Success with Created false; the hand stays raised and nothing changes, so no change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor holds an open Queued request and is connected to the room.
cases.inputs: operation: Lower; requestId: that request; actor: its owner.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Cancelled and a Lower change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor holds an open Invited request and is connected to the room.
cases.inputs: operation: Start; requestId: that request; actor: its owner.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Speaking with StartedAt now and a Start change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor holds an open Speaking request and is connected to the room.
cases.inputs: operation: Finish; requestId: that request; actor: its owner.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Finished and a Finish change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair; nobody is invited or speaking.
A Queued request exists.
cases.inputs: operation: Invite; requestId: that request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Invited with InvitedAt now. An Invite change goes to every reader and an invited-only notice goes to that person alone, so the room can tell them it is their turn.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair.
A Queued request exists.
cases.inputs: operation: Decline; requestId: that request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Cancelled and a Decline change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair.
Two Queued requests exist at positions 1 and 2.
cases.inputs: operation: MoveUp; requestId: the second request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success; the two positions are swapped and a MoveUp change is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair.
One Queued request already stands first.
cases.inputs: operation: MoveUp; requestId: that request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success with the queue unchanged; already first, there is nothing to move and nothing is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair.
One Queued request already stands last.
cases.inputs: operation: MoveDown; requestId: that request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success with the queue unchanged; already last, there is nothing to move and nothing is published.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair (the Chair acts from the meeting page and need not be in the room).
Another participant holds an open Speaking request.
cases.inputs: operation: Finish; requestId: that request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: Success; the request becomes Finished and a Finish change is published. Inviting never switches any microphone on or off.

preconditions: Actor cannot read the meeting (stranger).
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the stranger.
cases.return: NotFound; nothing is saved and existence stays hidden.

preconditions: Actor's account is deactivated.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the deactivated Member.
cases.return: Inactive; 403 with no message code; nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair.
No request with that id exists in the meeting.
cases.inputs: operation: Invite; requestId: an unknown id; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: NotFound; nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting Ended; another participant holds a request.
cases.inputs: operation: Lower; requestId: that request; actor: anyone but its owner.
cases.return: NotFound; an action only its owner takes is answered as if the request did not exist, whatever the meeting's state.

preconditions: Meeting Ended; actor is a current participant connected to the room.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the participant.
cases.return: NotInProgress; 409 "Phòng họp chỉ mở khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra." (MSG117); nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor can read the meeting but is not connected to its room.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: that reader.
cases.return: NotInRoom; 409 "Bạn cần đang ở trong phòng họp để đăng ký phát biểu." (MSG458); nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is an ordinary Member.
A Queued request exists.
cases.inputs: operation: Invite; requestId: that request; actor: the Member.
cases.return: NotChair; 403 "Chỉ Chủ toạ hiện hành được điều hành lượt phát biểu." (MSG457); the former Chair after a handover is refused the same way.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair; someone is already Invited.
Another Queued request exists.
cases.inputs: operation: Invite; requestId: the Queued request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: FloorTaken; 409 "Đang có người được mời hoặc đang phát biểu. Hãy kết thúc lượt đó trước." (MSG459); nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor holds a Queued request (never invited) and is connected to the room.
cases.inputs: operation: Start; requestId: that request; actor: its owner.
cases.return: NotOpen; 409 "Yêu cầu phát biểu này đã thay đổi. Hãy tải lại danh sách." (MSG460); only an Invited request can start.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is an ordinary Member connected to the room.
Another participant holds an open Queued request.
cases.inputs: operation: Finish; requestId: that request; actor: the Member.
cases.return: NotChair (MSG457); ending someone else's turn is the Chair's.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; caller is the current Chair.
Two chairs invite at the same instant and the second write lands second.
cases.inputs: operation: Invite; requestId: the second Queued request; actor: the Chair.
cases.return: FloorTaken (MSG459); the committed write stays successful and the losing invite saves nothing further.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is connected to the room.
The write fails in storage.
cases.inputs: operation: Raise; actor: the participant.
cases.return: SaveFailed; 503 "Không lưu được thay đổi lượt phát biểu. Vui lòng thử lại." (MSG462); nothing is saved; no change is published.
